list.text: \f[faceprofbirch]\bOh?
\f[faceprofbirch]\bHello, \PN!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bI didn't even realize who you were at first.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bProf. Ivy told me to pick you up here.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bI'm Prof. Birch, it's a pleasure to meet you!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bThis isn't the place for a chat, though.\nCome along to my lab.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bOh, I came with my daughter, so there's no room for you to sit...
\f[facemay]\rSorry about that, \PN!
\f[facemay]\rWell, I'm May!\nGlad to meet you!
\f[facemay]\rMy Dad-oh, I mean Professor Birch- is always so focused on his research, that he misses some basic stuff like this.
\f[facemay]\rThat's why I always need to be around.
\f[facemay]\rHope you don't mind going in the back of the truck!
